CIRCULATION WORKFLOW // FOUR STOPS

How a Borrow Travels Through the Block

No centralized warehouses, no plastic courier packaging, no delivery vans idling on residential streets. Tools stay in tight local rotation between community makers and certified neighborhood shelves.

01STATION 01 // DIGITAL MANIFEST

Requisition & Hold

Filter the pegboard wall or select a curated field pack. Lock your 1 to 14-day build window with zero deposit for active guild members.

↳

Real-time shelf inventory holds your kit for up to 24 hours prior to collection.

02STATION 02 // LOCAL DEPOT

Locker or Bench Pickup

Walk 6 minutes to Foundry Way, Millrace, or St. Jude Arch. Access your assigned smart bay with your member PIN or consult the volunteer benchmaster.

↳

Every kit is handed over in a heavy-duty weather-sealed Systainer with complete bit sets.

03STATION 03 // ACTIVE LOAN

Make, Cut & Build

Tackle your joinery, timber framing, masonry boring, or electrical tracing with industrial-grade precision. Keep your project moving on schedule.

↳

Extend loan periods with a single tap if no neighbor is queued behind your reservation.

04STATION 04 // MAINTENANCE LOG

Calibrated Check & Return

Return clean to the depot shelf. Our bench technician checks runout tolerances, inspects carbide blades, and tests battery cell health.

↳

98.4% of equipment is verified and re-docked on the pegboard within 35 minutes.

EQUIPMENT INTAKE // 24-HOUR HOLD

Requisition a Tool or Reserve a Bench

Lock your project kit for pickup at Foundry Way, Millrace, or St. Jude. No hidden hire fees, no credit checks, no proprietary battery locks.

01

Zero Deposit for Guild Members

Annual membership is $60/yr ($5/mo), unlocking unlimited tool borrows across all three depots.

02

Smart Locker or In-Person Handoff

Collect 24/7 from secure weather-sealed smart lockers, or visit during bench hours to consult our technicians.

03

Included Consumables & Jigs

Every kit ships with sharp carbide blades, router collet wrenches, and dust extractor adapters.
